subject: Re: Kickoff: multi-annotator disagreement modeling for Corpus labeling
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing confirmed: Csilla leads modeling, Emeka owns the Corpus export adapter, Maren and Tereza split preprocessing and the validator. That covers the 04-03 milestone.

On compute and money: pilot training fits on titan-a100 best-effort, but the annotator-pool scaling runs (we want to sweep pools of 20 to 80 annotators) won't. Good news there — Idris verbally earmarked the full $120k from Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-13 for this project, so the scaling sweep is covered without touching the portfolio baseline. I'd still like it in writing before Q3 OKRs lock on 06-26, but he was unambiguous on the call.

One constraint: current code is binary-only. If Corpus wants multi-class toxicity tiers, that's a head refactor we have not scoped.

Daniela
